headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate public trend signals to identify potential security risks early in the development process, ensuring that ClearInstall users can make informed decisions about their dependencies. Leverage machine learning models for predictive analysis of dependency trends and vulnerabilities.
actions: Implement real-time dependency scanning using public repositories like GitHub to detect known vulnerabilities before installation.
Use machine learning algorithms to analyze historical data from projects such as Gathin23/cleanyourtv to predict potential issues with new dependencies.
